cohort: 112 women with cardiac disease (225 deliveries) matched with 450 healthy women (controls) who delivered between 2003 and 2014
finding: Women with a history of cardiac disease, particularly those with severe disease, had a higher risk of unplanned cesarean delivery and other peripartum complications compared to matched healthy controls.
mod_finding: Women with cardiac disease had a higher frequency of unplanned cesarean delivery (7.9%) compared to healthy controls (3.4%).
